<?php

require __DIR__.'/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require_once __DIR__.'/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();

use App\Models\User;

$student = User::where('role', 'student')->whereNotNull('program_id')->first();
$collegeId = $student?->program?->college_id;

echo 'Student: '.($student?->name ?? 'none').' | college_id: '.($collegeId ?? 'none').PHP_EOL;

echo PHP_EOL.'--- staffResponsibleFor('.$collegeId.') ---'.PHP_EOL;
$list = User::query()->staffResponsibleFor($collegeId)->orderBy('name')->get();
foreach ($list as $u) {
    echo '- '.$u->name.' | role: '.$u->role->value.' | active: '.($u->is_active ? 'yes' : 'no').PHP_EOL;
}
echo 'Count: '.$list->count().PHP_EOL;

echo PHP_EOL.'--- all counselors ---'.PHP_EOL;
foreach (User::where('role', 'counselor')->get() as $u) {
    echo '- '.$u->name.' | active: '.($u->is_active ? 'yes' : 'no').' | colleges: '.$u->colleges->pluck('id')->implode(',').PHP_EOL;
}
